results.content: Alaska's numbers are less severe but still soft for a state he carried by 13 points less than two years ago. A Morning Consult tracking poll put his net approval in the state at minus 5, worse than deep-red Wyoming but nowhere close to the minus-41 Morning Consult recorded in Vermont. Civiqs data through early June put his approval in Alaska at 43 percent, disapproval at 51 percent. [...] CNN's polling analysis found something odd sitting underneath those numbers. Alaska voters split almost evenly on Trump's job performance, yet Sullivan still held a narrow lead over Peltola in the same surveys.
